headline: Anthropic Rises 17% at Close of First Session on Nasdaq
summary: Anthropic shares rose as much as 38.7% intraday to $115.10 in their first Nasdaq session, valuing the company at about $2 trillion. They closed at $97.17, up 17%.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco artificial intelligence company developing the Claude AI models, and its public listing is a closely watched test of investor appetite for AI companies.
why_moved: Shares opened strongly and hit an intraday high of $115.10, a 38.7% gain, before fading through the session to close at $97.17.
original_headline: Anthropic sube 17% al cierre de su primera sesión en el Nasdaq
